maml:description.maml:para: Retrieves registered companies, optionally filtering by CNPJ or active status.
Returns registered company configurations. When provided, IsActive filters the results.
Company CNPJ. Accepts the formats supported by this command and its validation rules.
Filters companies by active or inactive status.
Registers a company for fiscal document processing.
Validates inputs, registers the company, and persists its configuration. XmlPath must exist; OutputPath is created when necessary. The module does not modify the source XML directory.
Company CNPJ. Accepts the formats supported by this command and its validation rules.
Company legal name.
Brazilian state abbreviation (UF).
Fiscal environment: Homologacao (test) or Producao (production).
Existing directory containing XML files generated by the ERP.
Optional directory containing national NFS-e XML files.
Optional inbound XML directory; not scanned by the current closing workflow.
Optional trade name.
Optional state tax registration number.
Destination for fiscal closing files.
Path to an A1 certificate (.pfx).
A1 certificate password as a SecureString.
Primary recipients of the fiscal closing email.
Carbon copy (Cc) recipients.
Blind carbon copy (Bcc) recipients.
Company-specific SMTP configuration.

command:example.maml:title: Example 1
command:example.dev:code: $p = @{ Cnpj = '11222333000181'; RazaoSocial = 'TEST COMPANY LTD'; Uf = 'SP'; Ambiente = 'Homologacao'; XmlPath = 'C:\ERP\XML' }; New-PipeCompany @p

maml:description.maml:para: Updates the configuration of a registered company.
Updates the supplied fields and preserves omitted values, subject to company registration validation.
Company CNPJ. Accepts the formats supported by this command and its validation rules.
New company legal name.
Trade name.
State tax registration number.
Brazilian state (UF).
Fiscal environment.
Directory containing outgoing XML files.
Directory containing national NFS-e XML files.
Optional directory containing inbound XML files.
Directory for output files.
Path to the A1 certificate.
Certificate password.
Primary recipients.
Carbon copy (Cc) recipients.
Blind carbon copy (Bcc) recipients.
Specific SMTP configuration.
Sets whether the company is active.
Removes the registration of an inactive company.
Removes the configuration of an inactive company. Associated file deletion is optional and controlled by DeleteFiles.
Company CNPJ. Accepts the formats supported by this command and its validation rules.
Also requests deletion of associated files, as defined by the command contract.
Retrieves the global SMTP configuration.
Reads the global SMTP configuration persisted by PipeDFe.
Creates or updates global SMTP settings.
Persists global SMTP settings. Initial configuration requires Server, Port, Ssl, Username, Password, and From. Subsequent updates preserve omitted fields.
SMTP server address.
SMTP server port.
Enables SSL/TLS.
SMTP authentication username.
SMTP password as a SecureString.
Sender email address.
Optional technical sender address.
Optional reply-to address.
Timeout in seconds.

command:example.maml:title: Example 1
command:example.dev:code: $password = Read-Host 'SMTP password' -AsSecureString; $smtp = @{ Server = 'smtp.example.com'; Port = 587; Ssl = $true; Username = 'account@example.com'; Password = $password; From = 'account@example.com' }; Set-PipeSmtp @smtp

maml:description.maml:para: Tests SMTP connectivity and authentication.
Probes TCP connectivity and attempts to send a test message to the sender address. Can use global, company-specific, or directly supplied SMTP settings.
CNPJ of the company whose configuration will be tested.
SMTP configuration supplied directly.
Test timeout in seconds.
Detects numbering gaps in indexed fiscal documents.
Checks document numbers by model and series within the specified period. Numbering gaps do not prove that documents were issued or that an irregularity occurred.
Company CNPJ. Accepts the formats supported by this command and its validation rules.
Optional period start.
Optional period end; requires StartDate when specified.
Runs the fiscal document closing workflow for one or more companies.

By default, processes the previous full calendar month for all active companies. Creates indexes and closing archives, generates delivery reports, and coordinates SMTP notifications with persistent duplicate-send protection.
One or more company CNPJs to process.
Optional period start.
Optional period end; requires StartDate when specified.
Checks the health of company SQLite indexes.
Checks whether the SQLite index exists and whether its schema version matches the expected version. Returns Healthy, Degraded, or Unhealthy status. Does not check SMTP connectivity.
Optional company CNPJ. When omitted, checks all active companies.
Records the verified SMTP outcome of an indeterminate delivery.

Use the delivery ID and the exact UTC attempt timestamp shown in the warning. Resolve only after verifying acceptance with the SMTP provider or recipient. Accepted marks the delivery as Delivered. NotAccepted marks it as Failed and the next normal closing can retry. The reason and previous error are recorded with the state change. This command sends no email.
Company CNPJ.
Delivery identifier shown in the warning.
Exact UTC attempt timestamp shown in the warning.
Accepted for confirmed acceptance, or NotAccepted for confirmed non-acceptance.
Evidence supporting the decision. Keep credentials and fiscal data out of the reason.

dev:remarks.maml:para: Simulates resolving an attempt after SMTP logs confirm non-acceptance.
